turns.assessment: The failure is isolated to lightpath och200 in the S17-to-S22 direction. The S17 transmitter raised EQPT_TX_FAIL exactly when the S22 receiver and client failed; S22 subsequently lost received power and the channel monitor lost only that channel. All four S17-to-S22 amplifiers showed no change, strongly excluding an amplifier or span-wide plant failure. This directly supports failure of the transmit laser in trx.och200.a.

proposals.rationale: The S17 line interface raised EQPT_TX_FAIL at onset, while the far-end receiver at S22 reported OCH_LOS and lost optical power. The downstream OCM also lost the channel, with no corresponding changes in the S17-to-S22 amplifier chain.

A broader card failure could also remove the transmitted channel, but the specific transmit-failure alarm and continued unchanged receive-side telemetry at the S17 interface favor a laser-only failure over failure of the whole card.
